query:
UPDATE event_series
             SET until_instant = least(
                     coalesce(until_instant, 'infinity'::timestamptz),
                     'epoch'::timestamptz + $2::bigint * interval '1 millisecond'
                 ),
                 schedule_id = NULL,
                 hidden = false,
                 updated_at = now()
             WHERE schedule_id = ANY($1::uuid[])
